hyperedges.label: Web UI build and packaging flow

nodes.label: Launcher_FRONTEND_DIST_DIR (prebuilt dist option)
nodes.rationale: Lets offline/distro builds supply a separately built frontend so npm is never invoked during the CMake build.

nodes.label: Launcher_WEBUI_ALLOW_DEV_URL / MATERIALMC_WEBUI_ALLOW_DEV_URL
nodes.rationale: Dev-server URL loading is compiled into WebUiHost.cpp only in Debug builds unless explicitly allowed.

nodes.label: Platform WebView backend selection (WebKitGTK / WebView2 / WKWebView)
nodes.norm_label: platform webview backend selection (webkitgtk / webview2 / wkwebview)
nodes.rationale: LinuxWebView.cpp skips the Qt PCH because GTK headers clash with Qt keyword macros.

nodes.label: MaterialMC React frontend (React 19 + TypeScript + Vite)
nodes.rationale: UI contains no launcher logic; rendered by system WebView and talks to the C++ backend only via a typed API.

nodes.label: npm ci + npm run build pipeline
nodes.norm_label: npm ci + npm run build pipeline
nodes.rationale: node_modules is reinstalled only when package-lock.json changes (stamp file), then the bundle is type-checked, built to dist/ and copied to the staging dir next to the launcher binary.

nodes.label: CSP connect-src 'none' (no page network access)
nodes.rationale: Security model: page cannot reach the network; all I/O goes through the backend bridge.

nodes.label: No mock data rule
nodes.rationale: Every screen shows real backend data or an explicit empty/error state; missing backend features get TODO(webui) instead of fake controls.

nodes.label: No polling / event-driven stores rule
nodes.rationale: UI subscribes to backend events (useEvent, hooks/stores.ts) instead of polling; long lists use VirtualList.

nodes.label: Typed calls only rule (methods.ts + client.ts CONTRACT + C++ handler)
nodes.norm_label: typed calls only rule (methods.ts + client.ts contract + c++ handler)
